input.user_message: Talking-to-camera edit of Caro at Merope. Start at "Hi, I'm Karolina, I'm from Ecuador" and end right after "I'm gonna be here all week". Cut her slip "with bread, no," so it says "waffle cookie with blackberry jam". Also cut my half question "how are you gonna". Captions for both voices, and spell these right: Oblea de la Casa, dulce de leche, leche condensada, Merope. Title: "Colombian dessert, Ecuadorian hands". Show "MEROPE" in big letters the first time she says Merope. No text on her face or on the plate. About 35 seconds.
